hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED MODEL (economics, not an edge test): per-firm prop economics at given Sharpe with firm-optimal vol. Model = copy of scripts/apex_model.py extended in agents/daily/w1-prop/prop_model.py. Strategy return per trading day (252/yr) = mu+s*e, e = Student-t(5) scaled to unit variance, mu = S*sigma/252, s = sigma/sqrt(252); each day split into 4 equal sub-steps (each t5 noise, same total moments) so intraday trailing drawdown and daily loss limits see an intraday path. S is the strategy's annual Sharpe NET of trading costs (spread+commission+swap/funding), dollar risk fixed on the starting balance (no compounding). sigma = annual vol as % of starting balance, chosen per firm and per S from the grid {1,2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12,15,20,25,30,40}% separately for the evaluation (sigma_e) and the funded phase (sigma_f), maximizing mean pre-tax net dollars per slot-year. Economics by renewal-reward: one slot = buy evaluation, run until pass / breach / expiry, rebuy on fail; on pass pay activation fee (if any) and run the funded account until breach, firm-imposed closure (max payouts) or a 3-year horizon, then rebuy. Rate per slot-year = E[cycle reward]/E[cycle length]; reward = trader share of payouts + refunds - all fees (eval, rebuys, activation, monthly subscriptions while in evaluation, data/API fees). Payouts: at each firm payout date the trader withdraws the firm's maximum allowed (min of cap and the allowed fraction of profit above the payout floor) if it is >= the firm minimum; trader keeps split. Consistency rules and news/one-sided-bet rules are NOT modeled (noted per firm). Firm parameters are taken mechanically from agents/daily/w1-prop/rules.csv (the verified rules table) for one standard program per firm; any value marked unverified is used but flagged. Outputs per firm x S in {0.8,1.0,1.2,1.5,2.0} (and 1.17): pass probability per attempt, mean funded lifetime (trading days), mean payouts per funded account, fees per slot-year, ROS = (payouts - fees)/fees per year after 25% tax on positive net (the >=20% test uses after-tax ROS), and fleet dollars/yr = slots at the per-person max x per-slot rate (fleet copies one strategy, so accounts are perfectly correlated; fleet p10 = slots x per-slot p10). Min Sharpe for ROS>=20% found by bisection on S in [0.3,3.0]. n = 4000 paths per (firm, S, sigma), seed 11. Not a test of any market edge: no market data is used, so no out-of-sample split applies; the gate t>=3.5504 does not apply to these rows.
data: no market data; firm rules table rules.csv (2026-10-11)
